candidates.name: Claude computer-use tool
candidates.verdict: GA on Claude API (computer_toolset_20260801); run in sandbox VM; ZDR eligible

decision: Plain Playwright for tests and scripted automation, with MCP for Claude Code to explore pages. Use Claude's computer-use tool only for desktop/legacy UIs inside an isolated VM (source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/computer-use-tool).
